result.document_summary: A page from the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Article 3) covering police-regulated business and occupation permits (investigation, issuance, renewal, penalties), served under a URL for the algorithmic rent-pricing division but containing no rental housing rules in this part.
result.notes: This part contains only police permit provisions (San Diego Municipal Code §§ 33.0303-33.0405: permit investigation, fingerprinting, denial grounds, fees, renewal, change of ownership, penalties). Although the source URL refers to Division 11 (Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price Fixing, § 98.1103), the text of that division is not included in this part, so no rule in the six rental housing categories can be extracted. The criminal-history provisions here concern permit applicants for police-regulated businesses, not tenant screening.
